title: Hooded Figure with Candles
description: A hooded figure in a long black robe stands barefoot on a dark platform covered in glowing marks and water. The figure has no visible face and holds hands out toward three lit candles floating in the air while three dark birds fly around with glowing ribbons and three pale hands rise from below holding small houses and figures.
prompt: A large hooded figure in a flowing black robe stands barefoot on a dark cracked platform with glowing marks and water pools. The figure has a blank white face area and raises both hands toward three tall lit candles floating in the air. Three dark birds fly around the figure with glowing purple ribbons. In the sky above is a large broken moon covered in multiple eyes with cracks of light. Below the platform three pale hands rise from the ground holding small glowing houses and figures. Colorful glowing flowers grow around the platform against a dark starry background with purple and yellow nebula.
